guard: Two real public users and separate signerless workers retain explicit sharing, exact owner attribution and allowed source CLI effects.
why: Only test fixture/worker dependency mutations are selected. No product guard is changed. The real public acquisition and source CLI entries must reach their named predicates.

The existing build is a prerequisite. Mutations change only directly executed fixture/worker source, so no compiled mutant is produced. The stock runner verifies the restored source SHA and this exact public entry must pass after every restore; no rebuild or universal retirement is claimed.
The wire/account witness and all original component proofs remain separate. Broker-denied negatives are not claimed to kill a bypassed worker admission guard.
